desc:
Chatbot handoff to a live person is the moment an assistant stops answering and your team takes over. Ecom Swift LLC sets up clear triggers and passes the whole conversation to staff, so customers never have to explain a problem twice.

## What is a chatbot handoff?

A chatbot handoff is the point where an automated assistant transfers a conversation to a human, together with the context needed to continue. A good handoff includes the chat transcript, the customer's contact details and a short summary of what they want. A bad one simply says "please email us" and drops the customer.

Most chatbots can handle the easy questions. What defines the experience is what happens with the hard ones: an angry message, a payment problem, a request that falls outside the bot's content. That is where customers decide whether your business is worth staying with.

## Why the handover decides how customers judge you

When a visitor asks for a person, they already feel the bot has not helped. If the next step is a dead end, a long form or a request to repeat everything, frustration turns into a lost customer or a public complaint. If a named team member picks up the thread and already knows the issue, the same moment becomes a point in your favor.

Handoff also protects your staff. Without rules, the bot either holds on to chats it should release or sends everything to your inbox, which defeats its purpose. Set triggers and routing keep your team focused on conversations that need judgment, while routine questions stay with the assistant.

## What good handoff design includes

- A visible, easy way for the customer to ask for a person at any time.
- Automatic triggers for anger, payment trouble, repeated confusion and sensitive topics.
- The full transcript delivered with the message, not just the last line.
- A short summary on top, so staff can read the issue in seconds.
- Contact details captured before the chat ends, if the customer leaves.
- Delivery into the tool your team already uses: email, Slack, Teams or a helpdesk.
- Routing by topic, so billing questions reach billing and product questions reach sales.
- An out-of-hours message that states when a reply will come.
- Opening hours and holiday rules, so promises match reality.
- Reporting on why chats were handed over, so you can fix the causes.

## What we do

First we list the situations where a person should step in. Together we choose the triggers: an explicit request, strong negative wording, a refund or payment issue, a topic the bot should never handle and a rule for when the same question fails twice.

Then we build the path. The Basic package sends the full chat to an email inbox and captures contact details. The Standard package adds a summary, routing by topic and delivery into Slack, Teams or your helpdesk. The Premium package lets staff take over a live conversation, adds hours and holiday rules and produces a report of handoffs by reason.

We test with your team using realistic scenarios, including late-night requests and messages written in a hurry. You receive a short staff guide explaining what arrives, where it appears and how to answer.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell customers plainly when a person is joining and what happens next.
- Set a reply time you can actually meet.
- Send urgent topics to a person straight away.
- Review the handoff reasons and fix the questions that cause them.
- Let staff see the whole chat before they reply.

**Avoid:**
- Hiding the option to reach a person behind several menus.
- Making customers fill in a long form before a handover.
- Promising an instant reply when no one is working.
- Routing every chat to one overloaded inbox.
- Letting the bot keep arguing with a customer who has asked for help.

## Who this service is for

This service suits a shop owner who answers customers personally and wants the bot to pass on only what matters. It suits a support team that already uses a helpdesk and wants chats to arrive as tidy tickets. It also suits a business with limited opening hours that needs a polite way to collect details overnight and reply in the morning.

## What we need from you

Tell us who should receive handoffs and in which tool. Share your opening hours, any holidays and the topics that must always reach a person. We need access to your chatbot and to the destination tool, given as a team member, staff user or developer user, never as a shared password. We will confirm each trigger with you before it goes live.
